name: Kinoshita Yuuka
source: One of [url=/c22265]Mariko's[/url] underlings who stands out due to being abnormally skinny. She and Tsuyoshi are pretty similar, however, she bullies Tsuyoshi so in exchange, she won't be bullied by Mariko. She is also very insecure of her body and doesn't like people touching it.
translation: [url=/c22265]真理子[/url]的手下之一，因为瘦得异常而格外显眼。她和刚很相似，却为了不被真理子欺负而选择欺负刚。她对自己的身体非常没有自信，不喜欢别人触碰。
